name: Prodolzhat' zhit'...
source:
Which is more important — to go with your loved one to the end, or to stop him on the edge of the abyss?

Artyom pulled out a lucky ticket: after a shift in "Sovenok" with Alisa, the pioneer did not go to his world, but left with the girl on a bus to the very regional center that was talked about so much in the camp.

What awaits them — the scary but fun 90s, stormy love, or a personal tragedy? Or maybe all at once?
